decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (AC-FILES\131HEST, sheets 1 of 3, 2 of 3, 3 of 3 and Design and Access Statement received 9th May 2008 and 131_4 received 29th April 2010) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 11am am to 11pm

Condition : 4 - No later than 3 August 2011, the developer shall construct a secure storage area in the rear yard of the site, immediately adjacent to the rear access door to the shop, to be surrounded by a 2 metre high close boarded timber fence which shall be equipped with two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins, and with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area shall be made permanently available and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable waste and food waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 5 - No later than 3 August 2011, details of a scheme to insulate the first floor above from the noise from within the ground floor takeaway shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented within 3 months from the date of the permission and retained thereafter.

Condition : 6 - No later than 3 August 2011, the shop front framework and the roller shutter on the front of the premises shall be painted dark green with a graffiti resistant coating and shall be maintained in this colour thereafter.  Any graffiti which may be applied to the front of the roller shutter thereafter shall be promptly removed
Condition : 7 - No later than 3 August 2011, the approved fume extraction system shall be installed and permanently maintained.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of condition 6 (graffiti resistant coating) of planning approval 00600/131/P11 dated 24/12/2010 for the Continued use of ground floor as Use Class A5 (hot food take-away), installation of fume extraction ducting at rear, and retention of shop front to amend the compliance period to three months commencing on 1 April.
